编辑图像或将图像与文本指令组合

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的主图片。您要编辑的图像。单独使用它来改变衣服、背景、灯光或物体。适用于：肖像·产品照片·人物·时尚摄影

步骤 2. 添加第二张图像（可选）。上传另一张图像以合并两张照片，将主题放入新场景中，或借用其中的背景或物体。跳过此步骤以编辑一张图像。

步骤 3. 描述您的编辑。准确写出您想要的内容，并在组合图像时命名它们，例如“将图像 1 中的人放在图像 2 的城堡内”或“将服装换成黑色皮夹克”。

步骤 4. 点击运行并下载。该模型只需几个步骤即可生成编辑。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop · Figma · Canva · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（720 x 1280·6 个步骤·指导 1·随机种子）是几乎每次编辑的正确起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 Mage Flow Edit Turbo（Microsoft 的快速开源编辑模型）编辑和组合文本指令中的图像。它需要一张或两张图像。有了它，它就可以改变背景、服装、灯光或物体。对于两张照片，它会将它们合并，这样你就可以将一张照片中的人物放入另一张照片的场景中，或者将一个物体拖过。 Qwen3-VL 编码器读取您的参考并遵循指令，而 Flux2 Klein 一致性 LoRA 在您组合两个图像时保持复合材料干净。 Turbo 意味着步骤很少，因此大约 20 秒即可返回编辑结果。您上传图像，描述编辑，然后下载结果。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适用对象：希望在 ComfyUI 中进行基于指令的编辑和两图像合成，而无需从头开始连接节点的创作者、营销人员和产品团队。不适用于：零迭代的像素完美修饰。复杂的合成仍然需要清晰的提示，并且某些编辑需要几次尝试。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的主图像，如果您想合并两张图像，请上传第二张图像。

  2. 描述编辑过程，在组合图像时命名图像，然后运行。

  3. 下载结果，为任何编辑器做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每个编辑都会在大约 20 秒内返回，因此尝试变化可以很快。提示会完成工作：命名环境、衣服、物体、灯光和相机角度，结果会变得更清晰。有几件事需要知道。清晰、高分辨率的输入比压缩或低分辨率的输入编辑得更好。两个参考图像合成得很好，但非常拥挤的场景和微小或遥远的面孔则更难。想要更清晰的输出吗？将步骤增加到 8 到 10。想要更快的预览吗？将它们降至 4 至 5。

使用案例

背景更换。通过文本提示将主题移至新环境，无需手动屏蔽。

图像合成。将两张照片组合成一个场景，将一张照片中的主题或物体放入另一张照片中。

服装和产品编辑。交换某人的衣服或将产品放入营销场景中，且环境完好。

人工智能摄影。只需一次指令即可将现有照片转变为社论、旅行、生活方式或时尚图像。

Mage Flow Edit Turbo 可以对您的图像做什么？

o.en:
Edit or combine images with a text instruction

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your main image. The image you want to edit. Use it on its own to change clothing, backgrounds, lighting, or objects. Works great with: portraits · product photos · characters · fashion photography

Step 2. Add a second image (optional). Upload another image to combine two photos, drop a subject into a new scene, or borrow a background or object from it. Skip this step to edit one image.

Step 3. Describe your edit. Write exactly what you want, and name the images when you combine them, like "place the person from image 1 inside the castle from image 2" or "change the outfit to a black leather jacket."

Step 4. Hit run and download. The model generates the edit in a few steps. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · Figma · Canva · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (720 x 1280 · 6 steps · guidance 1 · random seed) are the right starting point for almost every edit.

Overview

This workflow edits and combines images from a text instruction using Mage Flow Edit Turbo, a fast open-source editing model from Microsoft. It takes one or two images. With one, it changes backgrounds, outfits, lighting, or objects. With two, it merges them, so you can place a person from one photo into the scene of another or pull an object across. A Qwen3-VL encoder reads your references and follows the instruction, and a Flux2 Klein consistency LoRA keeps composites clean when you combine two images. Turbo means few steps, so an edit comes back in about 20 seconds. You upload your images, describe the edit, and download the result. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators, marketers, and product teams who want instruction-based editing and two-image compositing in ComfyUI without wiring the nodes from scratch. Not for: pixel-perfect retouching with zero iteration. Complex composites still need a clear prompt, and some edits take a couple of tries.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your main image, and a second image if you want to combine two.

  2. Describe the edit, naming the images when you combine them, then run.

  3. Download the result, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each edit comes back in about 20 seconds, so trying variations stays quick. The prompt does the work: name the environment, clothing, objects, lighting, and camera angle, and the result gets cleaner. A few things to know. Clear, high-resolution inputs edit better than compressed or low-res ones. Two reference images composite well, but very crowded scenes and tiny or distant faces are harder. Want sharper output? Raise steps to 8 to 10. Want a faster preview? Drop them to 4 to 5.

Use Cases

Background Replacement. Move a subject into a new environment from a text prompt, no manual masking.

Image Compositing. Combine two photos into one scene, placing a subject or object from one into the other.

Outfit & Product Edits. Swap clothing on a person or drop a product into a marketing scene with the setting intact.

AI Photography. Turn existing photos into editorial, travel, lifestyle, or fashion images from a single instruction.
